verdict.rationale: Data portability and vendor lock-in are fair questions for a security-key product, but the evidence pack never documents any feature for exporting stored credentials, accounts or configuration in an open format. Standards compatibility (WebAuthn) and the advice to log in with a backup key and provision a new one are adjacent behaviours, not a data-export capability. The open-source OpenSK firmware is likewise unrelated to exporting user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
